label: rem:rho-s3-holonomy-exposition
title: The $\rho$ representation as $S_3$ holonomy
html:
Remark. The \rho representation as S_3 holonomy

The representation \rho \colon B_3 \to \mathrm{SU}(2) specifies the exact holonomy of the symmetric group S_3\cong D_3 acting on the branched cover \mathcal{S} \to \mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}). As the Galois group of the cubic constraint it permutes the cubic's three branches, and it determines how the spectral Lagrange resolvents w_k are physically transported around the branch points.

The chiral sheets of the geometry are defined by these spectral coordinates. The conjugate pairs (w_1, w_4) and (w_2, w_3) tile the four non-trivial modes into a time-like pair (w_2,w_3) and a space-like axis w_1, and the projective ratios \eta_1=w_1/w_2, \eta_2=w_3/w_4 coordinatize the three branches on which S_3 acts (the braid-group action). The holonomy is built from two elementary operations:

  1. The rotation \alpha (order 3). The 3-cycle \alpha=\sigma_1\sigma_2 cyclically permutes the three branches. In the \mathrm{SU}(2) embedding it is the generator \alpha=\exp(\tfrac{2\pi}{3}e_3) of the \mathrm{SU}(2) generators; physically it rotates the time-like resolvent pair (w_2,w_3), carrying the dynamical phase of the Reeb flow and leaving the overall chirality unchanged.
  2. The reflection \beta (order 2). A reflection swaps the conjugate pairs (w_1,w_4)\leftrightarrow(w_2,w_3). In \mathrm{SU}(2) it is the generator \beta=\exp(\pi e_1), reflecting the space-like axis w_1 and implementing the geometric equivalent of parity inversion. The two braid generators \sigma_1,\sigma_2 (braid twist–flip) are reflections of this kind.

Together, the rotation and reflection generate S_3\cong D_3 with the dihedral relation \beta\alpha\beta^{-1}=\alpha^{-1}; the two braid reflections \sigma_1,\sigma_2 have product \sigma_1\sigma_2=\alpha, and \alpha^3=\mathrm{id} on \mathrm{SO}(3). The full S_3 holonomy is generated by these rotations and reflections of the chiral sheets.

Whenever \rho appears in braid-group representations or knot invariants, it acts physically by rotating the time-like modes and reflecting the space-like axis of the chiral sheets.
